hack.root_cause: Flash loan + spot price manipulation → inflated LP token valuation → excess BUNNY minting
hack.description: PancakeBunny lost $45M when an attacker used 8 coordinated flash loans to inflate the spot price of LP tokens, minting 6.97M BUNNY tokens as fraudulent rewards before dumping them and crashing BUNNY 96%.
